title: Operator Clearance Observer Callable Fail-Closed Result
summary: Record the operator-reported result that forgepilot_get_operator_local_execution_clearance_status became available through the Actions tab and was called successfully. The observer returned not eligible for guarded attempt because the operator-local clearance artifact was missing at .local/forgepilot/execution-clearance.json and the old FP-MCP-209 target execution commit 4bd1977 no longer matched the current ForgePilot HEAD 0f4ff5e. This resolves the prior FP-MCP-221 tool-discovery mismatch operationally and confirms the observer fails closed without side effects.
caveats: The assistant's current callable namespace still did not expose the observer directly; this checkpoint records the user's reported Actions-tab invocation result.
Because the observer was not directly callable from this assistant turn, the result is recorded as operator-reported observation rather than assistant-invoked tool output.
The old FP-MCP-209 request tuple is stale relative to current ForgePilot HEAD and should not be used for a new local clearance artifact as-is.
A fresh request and fresh approval bound to current HEAD are required before any future local clearance should be created.
No approval was consumed, no disable switch was cleared, no runner start endpoint was contacted, no OpenCode process was started, and FP-027 did not run.
boundaries: observer callable through Actions tab: true

structuredRecord.priorMismatch: FP-MCP-221 recorded that source/dist/service had the observer but ChatGPT callable discovery did not expose it.
